chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated from Faḍālah, from Abān, from al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the male slave and the female slave: do they bar others from inheritance when they themselves do not inherit? He said: “No.”

key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكَةِ: A female slave; here discussed in the same inheritance ruling.
key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكِ: A male slave; here discussed as a possible heir-related relation in inheritance law.
key_terms.يَحْجُبَانِ: They block or prevent other heirs from inheriting.
key_terms.يَرِثَا: To inherit; to receive a share of inheritance.

ai.seo_question: Do a male slave or female slave block other heirs from inheritance in Shia fiqh if they do not themselves inherit?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in inheritance law regarding slaves. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that a male or female slave does not prevent others from inheriting when the slave does not themselves inherit.
